tool_schemas.name: scan_directory
tool_schemas.description: Runs Semgrep against the specified directory using the provided configuration and returns the normalized scan output (including findings and metadata) for this execution. The request is validated to ensure `path` is an absolute directory path within the MCP workspace and `config` is either "auto" or an absolute config path; it raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when validation fails and NOT_FOUND when the directory or config file does not exist. It raises PERMISSION_DENIED when the target path is outside the allowed MCP directory or cannot be read, and INTERNAL when the Semgrep execution fails unexpectedly.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to scan (must be within MCP directory)

config.description: Semgrep configuration (e.g. "auto" or absolute path to rule file)

tool_schemas.name: list_rules
tool_schemas.description: Returns the set of Semgrep rules available to this server, optionally filtered by `language`; results are returned as a single unpaged list. It raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when `language` is provided but unsupported or malformed. It raises INTERNAL if the rule registry cannot be loaded.

tool_schemas.name: analyze_results
tool_schemas.description: Parses and analyzes a Semgrep JSON results file and returns derived analytics (such as counts and normalized structures) for downstream filtering/export. It raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when `results_file` is not an absolute path within the MCP workspace or the file is not valid Semgrep JSON, and NOT_FOUND when the file does not exist. It raises PERMISSION_DENIED when the file is outside the allowed MCP directory or cannot be read, and INTERNAL on unexpected analysis failures.

results_file.description: Absolute path to JSON results file (must be within MCP directory)

tool_schemas.name: create_rule
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Semgrep rule from the provided fields and writes it to `output_path`, returning the created rule metadata (including the resolved rule id and severity). It raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when required fields are missing, `severity` is not one of ERROR/WARNING/INFO, or `output_path` is not an absolute path, and NOT_FOUND when the parent directory for `output_path` does not exist. It raises PERMISSION_DENIED when `output_path` is outside the allowed MCP directory or not writable, and CONFLICT when a rule file already exists at `output_path`.

output_path.description: Absolute path for output rule file

message.description: Message to display when rule matches

tool_schemas.name: filter_results
tool_schemas.description: Loads a Semgrep JSON results file and returns a filtered subset of findings matching the provided criteria; results are returned as a single unpaged list. It raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when `results_file` is not an absolute path within the MCP workspace, when any provided regex (`path_pattern`/`message_pattern`) is invalid, or when `severity` is not one of ERROR/WARNING/INFO, and NOT_FOUND when the results file does not exist. It raises PERMISSION_DENIED when the file is outside the allowed MCP directory or cannot be read, and INTERNAL if filtering fails unexpectedly.

results_file.description: Absolute path to JSON results file

tool_schemas.name: export_results
tool_schemas.description: Converts a Semgrep JSON results file to the requested `format` (json, sarif, or text), writes it to `output_file`, and returns export metadata (including the chosen format and output location). It raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when `format` is unsupported or when either path is not an absolute path within the MCP workspace, NOT_FOUND when the input results file (or output parent directory) does not exist, and CONFLICT when `output_file` already exists. It raises PERMISSION_DENIED when paths are outside the allowed MCP directory or not readable/writable, and INTERNAL on unexpected export failures.

results_file.description: Absolute path to JSON results file

tool_schemas.name: compare_results
tool_schemas.description: Compares two Semgrep JSON results files and returns a diff summary (new, fixed, and persistent findings) suitable for scan-to-scan change review; results are returned as a single unpaged response. It raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when either path is not an absolute path within the MCP workspace or either file is not valid Semgrep JSON, and NOT_FOUND when either file does not exist. It raises PERMISSION_DENIED when either file is outside the allowed MCP directory or cannot be read, and INTERNAL if diffing fails unexpectedly.

old_results.description: Absolute path to older JSON results file

new_results.description: Absolute path to newer JSON results file

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects visible to the caller, optionally filtered by lifecycle `status`. Results are returned as a single unpaged list ordered by creation time descending. It refuses invalid filters with INVALID_ARGUMENT and returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller cannot enumerate projects.

tool_schemas.name: create_project
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new project rooted at `mcp_root_path` and returns the created project. The server validates that `mcp_root_path` is an absolute directory path within the MCP workspace. It refuses invalid paths or missing fields with INVALID_ARGUMENT, returns NOT_FOUND if the directory does not exist, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller cannot create projects.

mcp_root_path.description: Absolute path to the project root directory within the MCP workspace.

tool_schemas.name: update_project
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a project and returns the updated project. This endpoint is used to drive lifecycle transitions such as archiving an active project by setting `status` to `archived`. It refuses invalid transitions with FAILED_PRECONDITION, unknown projects with NOT_FOUND, and invalid fields with INVALID_ARGUMENT.

status.description: Project status; setting this performs a lifecycle transition.

tool_schemas.name: list_scans
tool_schemas.description: Lists scans for a project, optionally filtered by status, ordered by created time descending. Results are paginated. It refuses invalid filters with INVALID_ARGUMENT and returns NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist.

project_id.description: Project id to list scans for.

page_size.description: Maximum number of scans to return.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_artifact
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single artifact by id and returns its metadata, including status, error information (if failed), and any derived outputs (analysis_summary/comparison) when ready. It refuses unknown ids with NOT_FOUND and returns PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller cannot access the artifact.

metadata.name: MCP Server Semgrep
metadata.description: This backend stores Semgrep scan executions over directories, the rule configurations used, and the normalized findings emitted by Semgrep. It also tracks imported/created rules, derived artifacts (analyzed/filtered/exported outputs), and comparisons between two scan runs to support diffing workflow
